def: empty, i.e. (literally) profitless, or (specially), an idol

occurrences.text: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
And again, The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.
And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
